title: Discovery of Natural Compound alpha-Hederin via Large-Scale Screening as a Targeted JAK/STAT3 Inhibitor for Ovarian Cancer Therapy.
authors: Wang, Jiayu; He, Pengzhan; Liu, Cheng; Chen, Xin; Tan, Yilin; Qu, Rui; Zhang, Yan; Li, Zhou; Yin, Tailang; Yin, Zhinang
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦小分子抑制剂靶向JAK/STAT3通路治疗卵巢癌，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chemoresistance and metastasis are key obstacles to successful ovarian cancer (OC) treatment. Here, alpha-Hederin, a pentacyclic triterpenoid saponin, is identified as a potent and selective dual inhibitor of JAK1/JAK2 with promising therapeutic potential in OC. Integrating transcriptomic analysis, virtual screening, molecular docking, and biochemical validation, it is shown that alpha-Hederin directly binds the JH1 kinase domains of JAK1 and JAK2, suppressing their activity and downstream STAT3 phosphorylation. alpha-Hederin inhibits OC cell proliferation, epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), and metastasis in vitro, and suppresses tumor growth and dissemination in multiple mouse models, with minimal systemic toxicity. Mechanistically, alpha-Hederin blocks STAT3 nuclear translocation and downregulates oncogenic STAT3 targets including MYC, CCND1, and TWIST1. Rescue experiments using the STAT3 agonist Colivelin partially reversed these effects, confirming the JAK/STAT3 axis as a key target. Moreover, alpha-Hederin synergizes with cisplatin to enhance antitumor efficacy and overcomes platinum resistance in OC cells. Collectively, our findings highlight alpha-Hederin as a safe and effective natural JAK1/2 inhibitor that suppresses OC progression by targeting the JAK/STAT3 pathway, offering a compelling candidate for future clinical translation.
abstract_zh: 化疗耐药和转移是卵巢癌（OC）治疗成功的关键障碍。本文中，α-常春藤素（alpha-Hederin），一种五环三萜皂苷，被鉴定为JAK1/JAK2的有效且选择性双重抑制剂，在OC中展现出有前景的治疗潜力。通过整合转录组分析、虚拟筛选、分子对接和生化验证，研究表明α-常春藤素直接结合JAK1和JAK2的JH1激酶结构域，抑制其活性及下游STAT3磷酸化。α-常春藤素在体外抑制OC细胞增殖、上皮-间质转化（EMT）和转移，并在多种小鼠模型中抑制肿瘤生长和扩散，且全身毒性极小。机制上，α-常春藤素阻断STAT3核转位，并下调致癌性STAT3靶基因，包括MYC、CCND1和TWIST1。使用STAT3激动剂Colivelin的拯救实验部分逆转了这些效应，确认JAK/STAT3轴为关键靶点。此外，α-常春藤素与顺铂协同作用，增强抗肿瘤疗效，并克服OC细胞中的铂耐药性。总体而言，我们的发现强调α-常春藤素作为一种安全有效的天然JAK1/2抑制剂，通过靶向JAK/STAT3通路抑制OC进展，为未来临床转化提供了有力候选药物。
